description.message: Send a download link to your local ZipZap application.

sent.message: Added to the ZipZap queue. A held queue waits until you start it. This does not mean the download is complete.

received.message: Received locally. Waiting for ZipZap to confirm the queue.

timeout.message: ZipZap has not confirmed in time. The request may still be queued; check the app before sending again.

protocol.message: The local host could not confirm this request. Update ZipZap and reconnect the browser in Settings.

destination.message: Not queued: that filename is occupied. Open ZipZap and review a different filename.

app_rejected.message: Not queued: ZipZap rejected the request. Open the app to check the link, destination and queue limits.

app_start_failed.message: ZipZap could not start. Open or repair the app, then check its queue before sending again.

expired.message: The local receipt is unavailable or expired. Check ZipZap before sending again.

missing.message: Open ZipZap and connect the browser in Settings.

invalid.message: Use an HTTP/HTTPS link without embedded credentials.

privacy.message: No page tracking. No cookies exported. Explicit links only.

inbox_full.message: Not received: the local inbox is full. Open ZipZap and check pending requests before sending again.

host_rejected.message: The local host could not confirm receipt. Open ZipZap, check its queue and available storage, then reconnect the browser.

healthHost.message: Extension and local host connected. The app has no recent readiness signal; open ZipZap and check again. No download was started.

healthReady.message: Extension and local host connected. ZipZap was recently ready. Explicit link mode; no download was started.

healthTimeout.message: Connection check timed out. Open or repair ZipZap and try again. No download request was sent.
